# surflist

> surflist is a directory for surf trips, organised by destination. Each surf town has a hub page ("Surfing in <town>") linking to its surf schools, surf shops, places to stay (camps, hostels, eco-pods, campervans) and surf services like board repair. Browse from country to region to town, or by category.

## Browse by type

- [Surf schools](https://surflist.co/surf-schools/): Learn to surf or level up with schools and coaches near the break.
- [Surf shops](https://surflist.co/surf-shops/): Independent surf shops for boards, wetsuits, rentals and repairs.
- [Places to stay](https://surflist.co/surf-stays/): Surf camps, hostels, eco-pods and campervans close to the waves.
- [Surf services](https://surflist.co/surf-services/): Board repair, ding fixes and other surf services.
- [Blog](https://surflist.co/blog/): Everything surfing.

## Blog

- [The Ultimate Guide to Surfing in Sayulita (2026): Best Seasons, Surf Spots & Water Temperatures](https://surflist.co/blog/surfing-in-sayulita-2026/): When to surf Sayulita, the best spots from the town beach to San Pancho, month-by-month water temperatures, and what to pack.
- [The Ultimate Guide to Surfing in Ericeira (2026): Best Seasons, Surf Spots & Water Temperatures](https://surflist.co/blog/surfing-in-ericeira-2026/): When to surf Ericeira, the best spots from Foz do Lizandro to Coxos, month-by-month water temperatures, and what wetsuit to pack.
- [The Ultimate Guide to Surfing in Newquay (2026): Best Seasons, Surf Spots & Water Temperatures](https://surflist.co/blog/surfing-in-newquay-2026/): When to surf Newquay, the best spots from Fistral to Watergate Bay, month-by-month water temperatures, and what wetsuit to pack.

## Surf schools

- [Coconut Harry's Surf Shop](https://surflist.co/surf-schools/coconut-harry-s-surf-shop/): surf school in Nosara, Guanacaste, Costa Rica — Full-service Guiones surf shop and school with a big rental quiver and small-group lessons for all ages.
- [Nosara CR Surf School](https://surflist.co/surf-schools/nosara-cr-surf-school/): surf school in Nosara, Guanacaste, Costa Rica — Locally run school at Playa Guiones with ISA-certified coaches teaching all levels on Nosara's forgiving beach break.
- [Safari Surf School](https://surflist.co/surf-schools/safari-surf-school/): surf school in Nosara, Guanacaste, Costa Rica — One of Nosara's longest-running schools (25+ years), with ISA-certified local instructors and lessons for all ages and levels.
- [Iguana Surf](https://surflist.co/surf-schools/iguana-surf/): surf school in Tamarindo, Guanacaste, Costa Rica — The original Tamarindo surf shop and school, teaching beginners to advanced surfers in front of the town's beginner break since 1989.
- [Tamarindo Surf Academy](https://surflist.co/surf-schools/tamarindo-surf-academy/): surf school in Tamarindo, Guanacaste, Costa Rica — ISA-certified school on Tamarindo beach offering personalized group and family lessons, tied to the Cala Luna hotel.
- [Witch's Rock Surf Camp](https://surflist.co/surf-schools/witch-s-rock-surf-camp/): surf school in Tamarindo, Guanacaste, Costa Rica — Long-running Tamarindo institution running all-level coaching with daily video analysis, plus boat trips to Witch's Rock and Ollie's Point.
- [Caribbean Surf School & Shop](https://surflist.co/surf-schools/caribbean-surf-school-shop/): surf school in Puerto Viejo, Limón, Costa Rica — The established Caribbean-coast school run by local Hershel Lewis, teaching everywhere from beginner beach breaks to the Salsa Brava reef.
- [Surf the Jungle](https://surflist.co/surf-schools/surf-the-jungle/): surf school in Puerto Viejo, Limón, Costa Rica — Puerto Viejo school offering private clinics and all-inclusive packages with ocean-certified lifeguards and instructors.
- [Costa Rica Surf Camp](https://surflist.co/surf-schools/costa-rica-surf-camp/): surf school in Dominical, Puntarenas, Costa Rica — Dominical's long-running surf camp (20+ years) with local instructors, personalized lessons and its own in-town surf shop.
- [Dominical Surf School](https://surflist.co/surf-schools/dominical-surf-school/): surf school in Dominical, Puntarenas, Costa Rica — Locally owned, top-rated Dominical school offering technical small-group lessons and women's surf camps for all levels.
- [School of the World](https://surflist.co/surf-schools/school-of-the-world/): surf school in Jacó, Puntarenas, Costa Rica — Jacó surf camp and boutique school teaching all levels at Playa Jacó and Playa Hermosa, with intensive coaching options.
- [Tortuga Surf Camp](https://surflist.co/surf-schools/tortuga-surf-camp/): surf school in Jacó, Puntarenas, Costa Rica — Jacó surf camp running training programs for all levels since 2007, from first-timers to surfers sharpening their skills.

## About

Surflist is a curated directory of surf schools, shops, stays and services, organised by country, region and town. Every listing is checked against the business's own official website. To get listed, see https://surflist.co/list-your-business/ or email listings@surflist.co. Read more at https://surflist.co/about/. Everything surfing: https://surflist.co/blog/. Surflist also helps surf businesses earn mentions and get recommended in search and AI answers: https://surflist.co/agency/.
